comment: Inji Verify signs request objects only with Ed25519 (EdDSA). The signature verifies with OpenSSL against the x5c certificate (measured 2026-10-14), but suite release-v5.3.1 reports "Error verifying JWT signature using x5c leaf certificate".
Inji Verify's request object carries iss "verify.inji.test" (the bare SAN), while its client_id is "x509_san_dns:verify.inji.test"; the suite warns that iss differs from the client id.
